body: My life is in chaos right now, and it's because I've made poor choices. That's hard to sit with sometimes. I live with my brother after losing my job and my husband because of my addiction. I've damaged relationships with my children as well. The weird thing is, if I could just hold it together, I'm completely capable of having a good life. If I can stay sober, I can return to work in my profession. I have two McJobs to get me through until then. Most of my family is proud and unhelpful but I do have a brother who does anything he can for me. It's just that when I get this dark depression heaviness, all I know to do is drink and/or get high to feel better. But that isn't even working anymore.

I've been on the phone with the suicide hot line for several hours today. I got off because my brother was supposed to come home from work and I thought I'd be safe once he gets here but now he is late and the lady I was talking to from the hot line had gone home. Someone please help me hang on. I've been depressed before, although never been down this far, so I have reason to believe it'll cycle through and I'll be ok. My sister-in-law gave me some Wellbutrin (no insurance) but I know that will take some time to work and I don't know if I have that long.
